_description: Units available for training, per faction (random armies, tools/nn/armies, docs/en/training/armies.md). A new unit or faction is a new entry here; its passport must be in config/nn/units.json (cost multiplayer_cost, category, men), then py -3.14 -m tools.nn.armies.templates. slot: the unit's name in an army (slot_1, slot_2, ...); width: frontage in m at deployment (default men / rank_depth files x 1.5 m); generator: the faction's config of the game's army generator (cdir_military_generator_configs), whose templates set the proportions of template armies; budget_factor (default 1.0): the faction's gold relative to the other side's after the equal-budget draw (a side's budget is B x its factor / the larger factor of the two, so mirrors stay equal; Skaven 0.8: they won all 10 equal-budget whole battles in the game, docs/en/training/measurements.md).

mix._description: Share of armies (per side) built by the faction's army templates (as the campaign AI) and pure random within the pool and budget (as a human might, stacks included).

caps._description: Template armies only: share of an army's units (the lord counted) that may be of one passport category, rounded down, at least 1. Random armies have no caps.
